name: autotrade
description: Runs declared trading strategies on a bar-close or tick trigger and owns the per-strategy ledger. Signals come from technical-analysis and orders/balances from a broker module (stock-trading); this module decides quantity, tracks average cost and reconciles against the broker. An account is named by the broker module's alias, and that account decides real vs mock. Actions: cycle (one decision pass), reconcile, report/positions/orders/ledger (read the ledger), halt (kill switch), selftest. Tags: autotrade trading strategy ledger average cost position sizing risk limits reconciliation backtest 자동매매 매매전략 원장 평단가 포지션 리스크관리
_schedules: The cron declarations live in this module's folder: registered when the module is enabled,
withdrawn when it is disabled. Each file is scoped to one (broker, market) pair, because a
cycle calls a single broker's tools. Removing a name here retires that schedule.

action.description: gate = answer in one line whether this cycle may run (`active` + `why` + the first trade's `trade`). It is the first step of a trading pipeline and the place the human-set switches, the trading window and the kill switch are read. Follow it with `CONDITION active == true` and a disabled cycle ends quietly, with zero broker calls. cycle = run one decision pass for a strategy (called by the bar-close cron or a tick sink). on_stream_event = realtime frames arriving from a stream watch. reconcile = balance/open-order reconciliation only. report/positions/orders/ledger = read the ledger this module owns. pnl = realised profit as the ledger states it — today and cumulative, per strategy and per symbol, with fees and taxes separated from the gain and internal transfers kept apart from market sells. Costs no broker call. Unrealised profit needs a current price, so it is only computed for symbols passed in `marks`, and an unpriced holding is named rather than counted as zero. halt = trip the kill switch (one direction only; clearing it is a settings change). selftest = golden fixtures, touches no network. liquidate_all/cancel_all/resolve_unassigned/import_position = one-off human actions, approval-gated. plan_sweep = expand a declared search space into candidate runs for a pipeline to execute (each run is one technical-analysis call, fitted on one window and scored on another). rank_sweep = read those results back and rank them on the holdout window, flagging thin samples and rules that only worked in-sample. merge_sweeps = fold one symbol's ranking into a running total across symbols (call once per symbol, passing the previous `running`). rank_across = final ranking over every symbol swept, ordered by how consistently a rule beat buy & hold rather than by its best single result. plan_multi / rank_multi = the whole multi-symbol sweep in two calls, so the pipeline is four steps whatever the symbol count: FOREACH symbols -> candles, plan_multi, FOREACH runs -> technical-analysis, rank_multi. Each planned run already carries its own barsCacheKey, so the execution loop needs no outside reference. Prefer these over plan_sweep/rank_sweep/merge_sweeps/rank_across, which are the single-symbol primitives. record_orders = after the order loop, hand back `calls` and its `results`; acknowledgements move rows to acked/rejected and are stored verbatim, but never create a fill — only reconcile does that, from the broker's own record. reconcile takes `fills`, `openOrders` and `position` — all optional, each doing its part in that order — and is the only action that writes fills into the ledger. adopt = admit a sweep's winner into the strategy store. Pass `ranked` and `runs` **exactly as the previous steps returned them** — a score cannot be typed in by hand — and a rule that passes still **starts on the paper rung**. A measurement that falls short is refused with its reason recorded, so the next search does not dig the same hole. strategies = the adopted rules and their history. retire = stop one (one direction only; promotion comes from results, not from asking). review = the after-hours ladder: move an adopted rule up or down **on its own ledger's results only**, comparing its win rate against the backtest, with the paper and live books each read separately. No LLM judgement. next_revision = the one rule to revise tonight plus its material (current conditions, live record, refusal history). **Revising and discovering are different jobs** — revising searches around a rule that already runs, discovering is a separate wide search run when starting a new trade. request_condition = **ask a person for a screener condition** that finds symbols fitting the strategy; Kiwoom cannot create one over the API, so registering it in HTS once is a human step. bind_condition = link the seq of a registered condition. universe = the request list and each trade's current watchlist. screen_rank = turn a broker ranking response (turnover leaders and the like) into that trade's watchlist: keep the top N and record every entry and exit as an event. An empty response leaves the list alone — a quiet broker is not the same as an empty market. It is how a trade gets its symbols when there is no HTS condition to bind. match_conditions = take the broker's screener list and pair it with our requests **by name**, binding the seq — if the person creates it in HTS under that name there is nothing to copy by hand. Pass `watchId` too and it also remembers which trade's watchlist that watch's frames belong to, so the seq inside a frame never has to be guessed. resolve_unassigned = move shares out of the unassigned bucket into a strategy's book, at the bucket's own average. The bucket holds what reconciliation could not attribute — a hand-made trade, or ours with the trail broken — and it never guesses an owner, so this is how a person supplies one. Appends to the ledger; the invariant (sum of strategies plus unassigned equals the broker) is unchanged. Refused from a schedule: a correction is a human act. `broker` and `account` are optional — with one bucket row for the symbol they are read from it, and only a symbol held at two accounts needs them, which the refusal then names. `positions` lists the bucket under `unassigned`, with the account each row lives in. move_position = move a holding from one strategy to another as an internal transfer: no order, no fee, and at the position's own average, so the realised P&L is zero. This is the way back from an assignment made to the wrong strategy — the ledger is append-only, so a mistake is corrected by a further entry rather than by editing the old one. Refused from a schedule, and the receiving strategy must exist. resume = clear the global halt. Refuses while the ledger replay still disagrees with the positions — the halt is telling you the books do not add up, and clearing it without fixing that resumes trading on numbers that are wrong. Says which rows disagree. Does not touch the per-currency daily-loss halt, which raises and lifts itself, nor the emergency stop, which only a person moves. close_position = manually sell one trade's position (strategyId, optional symbol/qty; market order by default, pass price for venues without one) — human-only, approval-gated; returns broker `calls` to run, fills confirmed by reconcile. liquidate_all = the same over every held position, scopable with broker/account — scope it to venues whose market is open (an unscoped sweep sprays refusals at closed ones). write_off = append a corrective ledger row for a phantom quantity the broker never held (strategyId, symbol, reason required; default qty = ledger minus broker holding, default price = average so it invents no P&L) — the way out of a permanent degraded state.

strategyId.description: Which declared strategy to run. Omit on `cycle` to run every enabled strategy whose trigger matches.

bars.description: OHLCV rows for the strategy's symbol, newest last. Supply this (or barsCacheKey) when calling from a pipeline that already fetched the candles.

barsCacheKey.description: Cache key from the broker's candle response — expanded into `bars` before validation, so the rows never ride in the call.

signal.description: A technical-analysis `signals` response. Supply it when the caller already ran ta; otherwise this module asks ta itself.

quote.description: Current price snapshot for the volatility guard: {last, bid?, ask?}. Falls back to the last closed bar's close when absent.

position.description: [reconcile] this symbol's holding, already read: {qty, avgPrice}. The final arbiter of how many shares exist — the difference against what the strategies claim goes to the unassigned bucket or degrades them. Prefer `balanceRows` when relaying a broker response.

frames.description: Realtime frames delivered by the stream sink (coalesced).

cycleId.description: Idempotency window. Omit and it is derived from the last closed bar (bar-close) or the debounce window (tick) — one order per strategy per window.

symbol.description: Which symbol this call is about. On `cycle` it selects every enabled strategy declared for that symbol — which is what lets two strategies on one symbol offset each other in the ledger instead of sending opposing orders. Also required by reconcile and the one-off actions.

orderType.description: close_position/liquidate_all: market (default) or limit — limit requires price.

limit.description: Row cap for the read actions (default 50).

mock.description: Reserved by the framework — the account decides real vs mock, so this module only reads it.

account.description: [gate] Also narrow to one account alias, for brokers that issue a separate account per market. [adopt] The account orders are placed on.

space.description: [plan_sweep] Search space: {families:[ma-cross|ema-cross|rsi|bollinger|macd], fast:[], slow:[], low:[], high:[], bbPeriod:[], bbMult:[], stopLossPct:[], takeProfitPct:[], feeRate, taxRate, slippageRate, holdout}. Omit anything to take the defaults.

results.description: [rank_sweep] technical-analysis responses, in the same order as `runs`. A loop envelope (`{count, results}`) is accepted as-is.

runs.description: [rank_sweep] the `runs` array plan_sweep returned, so each result can be matched to its candidate and window.

running.description: [merge_sweeps/rank_across] the accumulator, passed back exactly as merge_sweeps returned it — $stepN.running. Omit on the first symbol.

minSymbols.description: [rank_across] how many symbols a rule must have been measured on to count (default: half of those swept).

barCount.description: [plan_sweep] how many bars the fetch returned — in a pipeline take it from the candle step's `_cacheMeta.totalCount`. With it, candidates whose indicator needs more warm-up than the holdout window can hold are refused up front (they would score zero trades whatever their merit) and listed under `unmeasurable`. Without it that check cannot run and a long moving average will look worthless rather than unmeasured.

role.description: [merge_sweeps] which set this symbol belongs to. 'select' (default) is where rules are chosen; 'confirm' is symbols kept out of that choice. rank_across ranks on the selection set and refuses to crown anything that did not also hold up on the confirmation set — choosing on a symbol set and scoring on the same one is the same error as choosing on a window and scoring on it.

symbols.description: [plan_multi] symbols to sweep, in the same order as `fetched`.

fetched.description: [plan_multi] the candle loop's `results` — each entry is one symbol's fetch, read for its `_cacheKey` and `_cacheMeta.totalCount`. A loop envelope (`{count, results}`) is accepted as-is.

confirmSymbols.description: [plan_multi] symbols held out of the choice. A rule is ranked on the rest and refused if it does not also beat buy & hold here — choosing on a symbol set and scoring on that same set is the same error as choosing on a window and scoring on it.

calls.description: [record_orders] the `calls` array cycle returned, unchanged. A loop envelope (`{count, results}`) is accepted as-is.

fills.description: [reconcile] the broker's execution rows, verbatim. Read by field name and attributed through the order they belong to; a row whose quantity or price cannot be read is returned under `unreadableFills` rather than dropped.

openOrders.description: [reconcile] the broker's unfilled-order rows, verbatim. An order of ours that is no longer listed and never filled is closed as canceled. [cycle] takes the same list, to collect our own orders that have gone unfilled for too long.

balanceRows.description: [reconcile] the broker's balance rows, verbatim (one per symbol). This symbol's holding is read out of them here, so the caller does not need to know which field holds the quantity. A row that is ours but unreadable is returned under `unreadablePosition` and the balance step is skipped rather than treated as zero. Use this instead of `position` when passing a query result straight through.

template.description: [adopt] Defaults for money, limits and order type. The conditions and the stop/target come from the measured candidate, so they do not belong here.

broker.description: [gate] Narrow this cycle to one broker — a pipeline calls a single broker's tools, so the two must not mix. [adopt] The broker orders are placed through.

minConfirmSymbols.description: [adopt] Minimum number of confirmation symbols not used in the selection (default 2).

reason.description: [retire] Why it was stopped — kept in the history.

minLiveTrades.description: [review] Closed trades required before a rung moves (default 10).

winRateSlack.description: [review] How far the live win rate may fall below the backtest before demotion (percentage points, default 20).

tradeId.description: Target trade id (from the `trades` setting). Omit for the first trade.

name.description: [request_condition] The condition's name — exactly the name to use in HTS.

criteria.description: [request_condition] What the condition tests. State indicators, comparisons and periods concretely enough to be typed straight into the HTS screener window.

rationale.description: [request_condition] How this condition fits the strategy.

topic.description: [on_stream_event] Which stream the frame arrived on.

rows.description: [match_conditions] The screener-list rows, verbatim. [screen_rank] The ranking rows, verbatim.

trades.description: [bind_bars] the `trades` gate returned, unchanged. Each entry carries its symbol, interval and rules.

plan.description: [cycle] the whole bind_bars result. It is what matches a signal to the strategy that asked for it.

signals.description: [cycle] technical-analysis responses in the same order as plan.runs. A loop envelope (`{count, results}`) is accepted as-is.

feeRate.description: [bind_bars/measurement] Trading fee rate (0.0005 = 0.05%). The venue sets it.

taxRate.description: [bind_bars/measurement] Transaction tax rate. Zero for crypto; 0.0018 on a domestic-stock sale.

slippageRate.description: [bind_bars/measurement] Assumed slippage. A backtest measured without it is not adopted.

fits.description: [adopt_fits] The (symbol, rule) pairs fit_symbols passed, unchanged.

conditions.description: [match_conditions] The screener-list rows the broker returned.

requestId.description: [bind_condition] The request id to link with the condition the person created in HTS.

minClosedTrips.description: [next_revision] This many closed round trips must accumulate after a rule changes before it is revised again.

proposal.description: [adopt] The search space the model proposed, unchanged. It is recorded as an event whether adopted or refused — keeping only the verdict loses why it was tried.

market.description: [gate] Also narrow by market — when one account trades both domestic and overseas, the two are separate schedules.

store.description: Which ledger this call acts on — live (mock and real accounts) or dryrun (paper). Omit to follow the current mode. Read actions (positions/orders/ledger/report) and the screen actions (close_position/liquidate_all/write_off/resolve_unassigned/move_position) both honour it; the cycle path always follows the mode.

trade.description: The trade id whose watchlist to fill (an id from `trades`).

top.description: How many of the top rows to keep. 0 or omitted keeps all of them.

symbolField.description: Name of the field holding the symbol code. Omitted, it is found by candidate names.

source.description: Name of where the list came from — recorded in the event log (e.g. ka10032 turnover leaders).

payload.description: The whole ranking response. Pass this instead of `rows` and the array is found inside it — the array key of a ranking response differs by broker (Kiwoom turnover leaders = `trde_prica_upper`).

marks.description: Optional current prices for unrealised profit, `{symbol: price}`. Only used by `pnl`/`report`. A holding with no price here is reported as unpriced, never as zero — "no mark" and "worth nothing" are opposite statements.

note.description: resolve_unassigned — why, written onto the ledger row.

fromStrategyId.description: move_position — the strategy giving the shares up.

toStrategyId.description: move_position — the strategy taking them on. Must be a strategy that actually runs.

output.description: Shape depends on the action. cycle -> {mode, ran, price, firedSides, placed[], dropped[], transfers[], positions[]}; reconcile -> {reconcile, ledgerDrift}; report/positions/orders/ledger -> the requested rows (report also returns `blocks` for a page); selftest -> {checks[], passed, failed}.

settings_fields.description: 원화 거래의 하루 실현 손실 한도입니다. 이 값을 넘으면 그날은 매매가 멈춥니다. 달러 등 다른 통화는 아래 칸에서 각자의 숫자로 정합니다.

원화가 아닌 통화의 하루 실현 손실 한도입니다. 통화별로 그 통화의 금액으로 적습니다(달러 한도는 달러로). 손실은 통화끼리 더하지 않습니다 — 환율은 이 모듈이 모르고 지어내지 않습니다. 여기 없는 통화로 손실이 나면 한도 없이 거래되는 중이라는 사실이 원장 이벤트에 남습니다. 기본값 USD 35 는 원화 5만원과 비슷한 크기로 골랐을 뿐이니, 실제로 쓸 금액은 직접 정하십시오.
미체결 지정가를 거둘 가격 이탈 폭(%). 시장이 주문을 지나쳐 간 방향으로만 잽니다 — 매수는 값이 오른 만큼, 매도는 내린 만큼. `unfilledAfterSec` 와 둘 중 하나라도 걸리면 취소하고, 0 = 이 조건 끔. 스캘핑처럼 시간이 신호의 일부면 시간 쪽을, 스윙이면 가격 쪽만 쓰는 식으로 전략별(`orders`)로 덮어쓸 수 있습니다.
미확인 주문을 "없던 일"로 확정하기까지 기다리는 초. 브로커 목록에도 없고 체결도 없고 잔고에도 흔적이 없을 때만 적용됩니다. 0 = 확정하지 않음(수동 정리).

시장별 주문 가능 시간. 거래소 현지 시각으로 적고 zone 을 함께 적습니다(미국은 서머타임이 자동 반영됩니다). open~close = 실계좌, extendedClose = 종이·모의 계좌에만 허용하는 확장 창(키움 SOR 은 NXT 애프터마켓을 20시까지 덮습니다 — 호가가 얇아 갭이 커지므로 배관 시험용으로만 엽니다). market 을 선언한 전략에만 적용되며, 여기 없는 market 은 주문이 거부됩니다. 조회·정산·미체결 정리는 이 창과 무관하게 계속 돕니다.
